source: outputs/cstr_calibration/20260924_092150_severity_grid plus the exploratory boundary check (scratchpad severity_llm_action_check.py, 3 seeds per severity)
rationale: v1 ranges lie almost entirely where only large corrections recover; 3B/7B local models propose ~10% feed cuts and failed 0/30 there. v2 straddles the boundary: at the mild end unchanged setpoints or a ~10% cut recover, towards the severe end >15% cuts are needed, so outcomes depend on the instance and on the size of the proposed correction. Severity remains continuous per episode.
paper_scope: claims hold for this declared population only; the v1 (more severe) ranges are reported separately as a regime where the tested local models do not produce recovering first proposals

excluded.leak: no grid action passed at any tested severity
excluded.note: pump 0.45, stuck 0.45 and outlet 0.5-0.55 lie at or beyond the v1 actionable boundary (unchanged setpoints can pass there); included deliberately so the population contains episodes where no correction is needed
